Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [You should improve your mailing system](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a29aa408a764bf460b136e0)
You should improve your mailing system. You spam me with questions about my experience while you still haven't delivered the furniture - just called me a day before delivery with a message 'it's still in the container, we don't know when it will be delivered.' So, as of now, my experience is one star.

May 29, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 10, 2026

Hi Greg,

Thank you for your feedback! I understand the timing of our review request could be frustrating. I'm happy to inform you that your dining table is ready for delivery scheduling as it has arrived at the warehouse hub in your area. If you need assistance, please let us know, and our Customer support team is happy to help connect you with the freight carrier for scheduling the white glove service appointment. Thank you for your patience!

Lulu and Georgia
